thought.text: Docker and Compose are available. Now I'll set up `.env` per the guide and start the build (in background, since a Next.js build can exceed a single command timeout).

reasoning_content:
Docker is running. Now let's proceed:

1. `cp .env.example .env`
2. Set required variables: PAYLOAD_SECRET, HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL. The example already has default values for all of these, but I'll set proper values anyway (PAYLOAD_SECRET at minimum 32 characters).
3. `docker compose up -d --build`
4. Wait for it to become healthy, `curl http://localhost:3020/api/health`

This is the basic setup per the guide. The production override requires MONGO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD and is for VPS deployment. The guide's basic setup is the standard installation path. I'll follow the basic setup (the guide's main "Setup" section).

Since this is a local environment without a public domain, for NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL I'll use the dev default `ws://localhost:1234`, and for NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL I'll use `http://localhost:3020` (the public port). Actually, in .env.example NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000 is the default, which is the internal port. In this environment the service is exposed on 3020. Since it's just used for metadata/og tags, either would work, but I'll set it to http://localhost:3020 which matches the actual exposure.

Also, regarding SMTP: per the docs, setting SMTP_HOST enables email verification, which blocks login until confirmation. The mailpit mailcatcher is part of the basic compose and is running, so leaving SMTP_HOST=localhost:1025 will work with mailpit. That's fine for the health check.

I'll generate the secrets. Then I'll run compose up -d --build. The build might take a while (npm ci + next build). The 600-second timeout per command is a concern. A Next.js build with Payload could take several minutes. I should run it in the background with nohup, write logs out to a file, and poll.

Let me write the .env and start the build in the background.

action.command: cd /workspace && cp .env.example .env && PAYLOAD=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && HOCUS=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && sed -i "s|^PAYLOAD_SECRET=.*|PAYLOAD_SECRET=${PAYLOAD}|" .env && sed -i "s|^HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=.*|HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=${HOCUS}|" .env && sed -i "s|^NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3020|" .env && grep -E '^(PAYLOAD_SECRET|HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET|NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL|NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL|MONGO_ROOT)' .env | sed 's/=\(.\{8\}\).*/=\1.../'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && cp .env.example .env && PAYLOAD=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && HOCUS=$(openssl rand -hex 32) && sed -i \"s|^PAYLOAD_SECRET=.*|PAYLOAD_SECRET=${PAYLOAD}|\" .env && sed -i \"s|^HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=.*|HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET=${HOCUS}|\" .env && sed -i \"s|^NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=.*|NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3020|\" .env && grep -E '^(PAYLOAD_SECRET|HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET|NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL|NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL|MONGO_ROOT)' .env | sed 's/=\\(.\\{8\\}\\).*/=\\1.../'", "summary": "Create .env with generated secrets", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
